package repository

import (
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// LessonRepository stores lessons.
type LessonRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, lesson domain.Lesson) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error)
	GetWithFields(ctx Context, id string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error)
	Update(ctx Context, lesson domain.Lesson) error
	Delete(ctx Context, lessonID string) error
	ListByCourse(ctx Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error)
	ListByCourseFields(ctx Context, courseID string, f queryfields.Set, filters filters.LessonFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error)
	ListBySection(ctx Context, sectionID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error)
}

// SectionLessonRepository stores section-lesson placement links.
type SectionLessonRepository interface {
	ReplaceBySection(ctx Context, sectionID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error
	Add(ctx Context, sectionID string, lessonID string, order int) error
	Delete(ctx Context, sectionID string, lessonID string) error
}

// LessonVersionRepository stores lesson technology versions.
type LessonVersionRepository interface {
	ReplaceByLesson(ctx Context, lessonID string, versions []domain.LessonVersion) error
	ListByLesson(ctx Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonVersion, error)
}

// LessonI18nRepository stores lesson localizations.
type LessonI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.LessonI18n) error
	ListByLesson(ctx Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonI18n, error)
}

// LessonRelationRepository stores directed semantic links between lessons.
type LessonRelationRepository interface {
	ReplaceBySourceLesson(ctx Context, sourceLessonID string, relations []domain.LessonRelation) error
	ListBySourceLesson(ctx Context, sourceLessonID string) ([]domain.LessonRelation, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, relationID string) error
}
